firstYear: A three-year degree with two majors: Mathematics (pure and applied) or Statistics and Data Science. The university describes the content as problem-solving, data analysis, probability and variability, modelling, logistics and logic, and you can add a second major, a minor or electives from other areas.
notThis: Not the same as UOW's Bachelor of Mathematics Advanced, a separate degree for high achievers that adds supervised research projects with academics. Both take three years, and each has an optional honours year.
